class.name: HTMLBehaviorStorage
class.brief_description: String key-value storage for an HTML behavior.
class.description: [HTMLBehavior.local_storage] persists values in [code]user://[/code] under the host's storage namespace. [HTMLBehavior.session_storage] stores values in memory for the lifetime of its [HTMLLabel]. Use [member HTMLLabel.storage_namespace] to assign a stable custom namespace when the document has no source path.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all values from this storage.

method.name: get_item
method.description: Returns the value for [param key], or an empty string when it is missing. Use [method has_item] to distinguish a missing key from an empty value.

method.name: set_item
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key]. An empty key is ignored.
